# Puritan Medical Products Blog

> Comprehensive resource for specimen collection techniques, swab selection guides, and diagnostic testing best practices from a leading American medical swab manufacturer.

The Puritan Medical Products blog provides educational content on proper swab collection methods across various clinical applications including STI testing, flu diagnosis, and genetic sampling. The site features detailed guides on swab materials, handle types, and transport media used in modern diagnostic laboratories.

## Key Topics

- Specimen Collection
- Medical Swabs
- Diagnostic Testing
- Swab Types
- Sample Collection
- CDC Standards
- Transport Media
- Nasopharyngeal Swabs
- STI Testing
- Rayon Swabs
- Cervical Swabs
- Viral Transport Medium
- Healthcare Guidelines
- Product Selection
- Microbiology

## Specimen Collection Guides

- [How to Swab for STDs: Chlamydia, Gonorrhea, Rectal, and More](https://blog.puritanmedproducts.com/how-to-swab-for-gonorrhea-and-chlamydia): Guide on STD swab collection techniques per CDC standards
- [How to Swab for the Flu | Comprehensive Flu Swab Test Guide](https://blog.puritanmedproducts.com/bid/339104/how-to-swab-for-the-flu-flocked-swab-sample-collection): Comprehensive flu swab collection guide with nasopharyngeal techniques
- [How to Choose the Right Cervical Swab: A Guide for Women's Health Clinics](https://blog.puritanmedproducts.com/how-to-choose-the-right-cervical-swab-a-guide-for-womens-health-clinics): Selection guide for cervical swabs in OB/GYN and STI testing
- [Genetic Swab Test: What You Need to Know](https://blog.puritanmedproducts.com/genetic-swab-test-what-you-need-to-know): Educational guide on genetic swab testing and buccal sample collection

## Swab Product Selection & Guides

- [What Are Rayon Swabs and How to Choose the Right One for Your Application](https://blog.puritanmedproducts.com/what-are-rayon-swabs-how-to-choose): Guide to rayon swabs, material comparison, and selection for procedures
- [Understanding Swab Handle Types: The Complete Guide](https://blog.puritanmedproducts.com/understanding-swab-handle-types-the-complete-guide): Complete guide comparing swab handle materials and performance tradeoffs
- [What Are Flexible Swab Handles? Benefits, Applications, and Buyer's Guide](https://blog.puritanmedproducts.com/what-are-flexible-swab-handles-benefits-applications-and-buyers-guide): Guide to flexible swab handle benefits and selection for healthcare
- [Extra-Long Swabs for Big Jobs: A Buyer's Guide to Super-Sized Swabs](https://blog.puritanmedproducts.com/extra-long-swabs-for-big-jobs-a-buyers-guide-to-super-sized-swabs): Buyer's guide to extra-long swabs for specialized medical applications
